ruleDefinitions.name: Cmd.EXE Missing Space Characters Execution Anomaly
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects Windows command lines that miss a space before or after the /c flag when running a command using the cmd.exe.
This could be a sign of obfuscation of a fat finger problem (typo by the developer).

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\/c.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\cmd\\/c.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\"cmd\\/c.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\/k.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\cmd\\/k.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\"cmd\\/k.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\/r.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\cmd\\/r.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\"cmd\\/r.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/cwhoami.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/cpowershell.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/cschtasks.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/cbitsadmin.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/ccertutil.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/kwhoami.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/kpowershell.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/kschtasks.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/kbitsadmin.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/kcertutil.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/c.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\ \\/c.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/k.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\ \\/k.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/r.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\ \\/r.*"))) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/c\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\ \\/c\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/k\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\ \\/k\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/r\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\ \\/r\\ .*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*AppData\\\\Local\\\\Programs\\\\Microsoft\\ VS\\ Code\\\\resources\\\\app\\\\node\\_modules.*") OR process_command_line = RGX("cmd\\\.exe\\/c\\ \\\.$") OR process_command_line = "cmd\.exe\ \/c"))
